headline: At least 7 Bangladeshi workers killed in Saudi factory fire
summary: The victims, all from Naogaon's Atrai upazila, died in a devastating blaze at a sofa factory in Saudi Arabia.
details: At least seven Bangladeshi workers have been killed in a devastating fire at a sofa factory in Saudi Arabia.
The victims were all from Naogaon's Atrai upazila, according to reports.
Expatriates’ Welfare and Overseas Employment Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury confirmed the tragedy in a press release issued Sunday night.
The Bangladesh embassy in Saudi Arabia is maintaining round-the-clock communication with local authorities and the accident site.
Officials have been instructed to ensure the swift repatriation of the victims' bodies and provide necessary government assistance and compensation to their families.
Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury expressed deep sadness, noting that the workers' contribution to the country's economy was immense.
caption:
A devastating fire at a sofa factory in Saudi Arabia has claimed the lives of at least 7 Bangladeshi workers.

At least seven Bangladeshi workers have been killed in a devastating fire at a sofa factory in Saudi Arabia.

The victims were all from Naogaon's Atrai upazila, according to reports.

Expatriates’ Welfare and Overseas Employment Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury confirmed the tragedy in a press release issued Sunday night.

The Bangladesh embassy in Saudi Arabia is maintaining round-the-clock communication with local authorities and the accident site.

Officials have been instructed to ensure the swift repatriation of the victims' bodies and provide necessary government assistance and compensation to their families.

Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury expressed deep sadness, noting that the workers' contribution to the country's economy was immense.

Source: Jamuna TV, Somoy News, The Daily Star, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: First contested presidential vote in 35 years: [[Jamaat-led alliance nominates Oli Ahmed]]
headline: First contested presidential vote in 35 years: Jamaat-led alliance nominates Oli Ahmed
summary: The 11-party alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami has nominated Bir Bikrom Oli Ahmed, a close associate of Ziaur Rahman, for the presidential election.
details: For the first time in 35 years, Bangladesh is heading toward a contested presidential election. While the BNP's two-thirds majority in Parliament ensures their candidate's victory, the opposition has decided to field a candidate.
caption:
A contested presidential election for the first time in 35 years. Jamaat-e-Islami's 11-party alliance has nominated Bir Bikrom Oli Ahmed.

For the first time in 35 years, Bangladesh is heading toward a contested presidential election. While the BNP's two-thirds majority in Parliament ensures their candidate's victory, the opposition has decided to field a candidate.
